title: tc-breakpoint-overlay
description:
Which breakpoint the page is at – a badge in the window's corner that opens a panel of every breakpoint, with a
ruler across the top of the window; ⌥⇧O to open it.

open.description: Whether the panel is open. Changed by the user unless a tc-open-change listener calls preventDefault()

breakpoints.description: The breakpoints, in px: min only, max only, or a range. Tailwind's by default

hotkey.description: Opens and closes it from anywhere ("alt+shift+o" is ⌥⇧O on Apple keyboards, Alt Shift O elsewhere); false turns it off

showRuler.description: While open, a ruler across the top of the window with each breakpoint and the width. Only when it follows the window

floating.description: The badge and panel float at the window's corner; off, it's a card in the page, always open

corner.description: Which corner of the window it floats in

ViewBreakpoint.description: A breakpoint: min-width only, max-width only, or a range between them, in px
